scope: Single-copper R5.2 CAD, documentation, reproducible source inputs and 1:1 print pack; no manufactured hardware or electrical validation
personal_checks: Read-only pcbnew versus source XML: 35 values and 87 pin-net assignments match final PCB
Final copper rules, layers, component side and explicit C6 branch coordinates read independently
C6 branch lengths 16.0068542495 mm and 16.311463197 mm verified from actual B.Cu segments
Author DRC/parity and ground geometry reports reviewed; DRC not rerun by critic
All four print preview pages inspected; final changed pages 3 and 4 inspected again
README_RU, ASSEMBLY_RU, task/requirements/decisions/sources and portable utility inputs reviewed
All 58 manifest hashes and lengths match

closed_findings.issue: C6 return detoured around first filter, approx 108.59 mm; intermediate 69.64 mm remained unsuitable
closed_findings.resolution: C6 moved below U1; both branches now local B.Cu, 16.01 and 16.31 mm

closed_findings.issue: W3 became electrically redundant after ground revision
closed_findings.resolution: W1/W2 required; W3 explicitly optional in documentation and print pages

limitations: Actual adapter body/capacitor fit requires 1:1 paper check before etching
0.35 mm narrow U1 annulus and 0805 C5 require careful LUT and drilling
Ground erosion does not model drill annuli, real etch tolerance or HF current
No physical manufacture, noise/bandwidth/protection/calibration or vehicle approval
Moved utility scripts were not used to regenerate the accepted CAD; generation changes UUIDs
